messages.subject: Multilevel mediation analysis using lavaan
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to do multilevel mediation analysis.

I have got a continuous dependent variable (y), two independent variables (categorical - x1 and x2), two binary mediator variables (m1 and m2), 4 covariates (c1,c2,c3,c4) and 2 levels (l1 - ID and l2 - geographical area). How can I do multilevel mediation analysis for this data? 

Thanks,
Anjana
